ext_description.message: Autofill credentials and TOTP codes from your self-hosted APS Vault. Quick search palette on Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+L.

status_no_url.message: Vault URL is not set — open the extension options.

status_not_initialized.message: Vault is not initialised — open it in a tab first.

palette_unavailable.message: The palette cannot open on this page (browser pages are not scriptable).

opt_url_help.message: Address of your APS Vault, e.g. https://vault.example.com. Ask the administrator to add this extension's origin (chrome-extension://<id>) to VAULT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

opt_bad_url.message: URL must start with https:// (http:// only for localhost)

opt_how.message: How it works: unlock from the popup with the master password; the extension keeps the session and fills login, password and TOTP into forms whose address matches a secret's URL. Hotkey Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+L opens a search palette on any page.

cs_no_matches.message: No secrets for this site — press Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+L to search

cs_locked_use_popup.message: APS Vault is locked — unlock it in the extension window (toolbar icon)

cs_https_only.message: Autofill works on https pages only
